_DISCLAIMER: Sandbox/TRAINING only (BANXE_ENV=sandbox, PROD_READY=false). The fleet-graph MCP server is READ-ONLY by construction: sqlite mode=ro, no write tools, no filesystem access beyond the DB artifact + committed maps (ADR-117).
_OPERATOR_NOTE: TEMPLATE ONLY — do NOT merge into ~/.claude.json or .mcp.json automatically. Operator applies by hand, replacing <PLACEHOLDERS>. The server serves DERIVED METADATA only (symbols/zones/owners/criticality/crosslink) — never foreign working trees.
_DB_SOURCE: FLEET_GRAPH_DB points at a downloaded fleet-graph-db CI artifact (fleet.db). Freshness is carried in every response (graph_commit + built_at); a stale or missing DB yields UNKNOWN objects, never empty=safe (NO-MOCK).
